critical_code_review_comments: is-drawer (factories) and is-modal (new shipment) have no Escape keydown handler; only the Detail view listens for Escape. Adding a shared handler on these overlays would match user expectation.

fmtAt only formats MM-DD-YYYY timestamps; entries created via create() use toLocaleString('MM/DD/YYYY, h:mm A') so their activity timeline dates fall through unformatted. Normalize stamp() to match SEED format.
Rows filter useMemo dep array uses eslint-disable — hides potential missed deps in future refactors.
